assumptions: Same22working-unit representation as1355; carrier occurrences align with those units and survive intact.
Every retained whole group contains at least one nonempty complete carrier of a pronounced nucleus; orthographicgroups are not silently assumed to be phonologicalwords.
All variants of every nucleus are included. Independently syllabic consonants must be counted where appropriate.
Fixed inventory across the chosen panel. No unstated exceptions for clitics, abbreviations or vowel-free writtenwords.
proof: Let tau be the minimum number of working types whose union touches every retainedword. Complementation gives tau=22-max_null_TYPES, not the token-mass ceiling.

Choose one working unit from each ofKnonempty carrierstrings. Because eachwordcontainsone completecarrier, these≤Krepresentatives hit everyword. ThusK>=tau. Codesmaybelong,ambiguous,orcollide; freeUDisnotrequired.
More generally, if allformsarecovered byBfamilies eachhavingacommonworkingunit, selectonecommonunitperfamily. ThenB>=tau evenifthenumberofvariantsisunbounded.

Therefore doublinga fixedvowelcode forlength,oraddingmarkerswhilepreservingitsbase,doesnotescapea<=8basefamilyexclusion. Independent long/short spellings that lackthecommonunit aredifferent andnotcoveredbythatshortcut.
retained_decision: EveryGE2reading excludes atmost8fixed always-present carrierforms/families underthecontract. FULLboundsare13IT,14RF,11ZL. No minimumactualvowelcount, no vowelidentity andno languageidentification.
